summary.answer: Rejects vehicle, remote-control or view-only-linked players. Applies team-owner-specific objective flag gates unless the arg2/arg3/objective override holds; only then forwards objId and predicted client number to objectiveisplayerusing. Rejects demos and non-Warzone/nonfull inventory; otherwise tests ALSO_ALLOW_SWAP in HUDItems.weapon3dHintState, defaulting that value to0. Preserves the exact direct source forwarding contract: return CoD.WaypointUtility.ConvertToColorInternal( f110_local0 .. "_Base", f110_local0 ). Other ordered reads/writes below occur before this return; callee/native effects and missing-input error behavior remain external. Preserves the exact direct source forwarding contract: return CoD.WaypointUtility.ConvertToColorInternal( f111_local0 .. "_Muted", f111_local0 ). Other ordered reads/writes below occur before this return; callee/native effects and missing-input error behavior remain external. Preserves the exact direct source forwarding contract: return CoD.WaypointUtility.ConvertToColorInternal( f112_local0 .. "_Bright", f112_local0 ). Other ordered reads/writes below occur before this return; callee/native effects and missing-input error behavior remain external. Lazily maps meansofdeathlist bundle entries into enum-indexed rows, caches even an empty table and returns the table by identity. Compares g_gametype dvar with each ipairs entry of the vararg table; returns true on equal entry and false after iteration. The n field records vararg count but is not used by ipairs. Returns true for absent/falsy roundsplayed or numeric0; otherwise false. Defaults ratio1, divides ammoInClip get() or1 by clipMaxAmmo get() or1 only when both fields exist, then returns ratio,0,0,0. Numeric0 denominator remains truthy and is not guarded/clamped. Requests compass corners/north. Nonzero north-x swaps normalized x/y outputs; else nonzero north-y keeps them aligned. If both north components zero returns nil,nil. Does not guard corner denominators or clamp. Requests corners/north and interpolates world x/y with swapped relative coordinates for nonzero north-x, unswapped for nonzero north-y. Both zero yields nil,nil; no clamp is added. Clamps interpolation amount0..1 then requests component-wise RGB interpolation on the supplied receiver. Saves original clip_over handler then installs a wrapper. On delivered clip_over with no next clip and nondefault state, EnemyKilled decrements a numeric kill counter and either replays DefaultClip or sets DefaultState; other nondefault states reset. Calls originalClipOver last without a nil guard. Sets the nested prematch timer first. False show flag hides numbers and returns; otherwise if start time exists, >5s delay installs faction_start and a one-shot timer, <=5s plays Start immediately. Finally starts the countdown numbers clip. No explicit timer cancellation/close hook appears. Gets predicted client number, concatenates GetClientClantag then GetClientName, and returns it. No separator or nil guard is added. Truthy _allowingButtonRepeats returns without native call; otherwise marks true before the native push request. This is a flag, not a local reference count. Falsy flag returns; otherwise clears it before native pop request. Failure rollback is not provided. Lazily builds the set of written weapon names plus current gameMode suffix, then returns the slot selected by SafeGetModelValue(viewmodelWeaponName). The none/killstreak_remote table is defined but unused; cache is not rebuilt when gameMode changes here. Only existing hints table and truthy indexed entry return the localized entry. Missing paths assign hash0 then fall through without returning it. When abilityHintIndex model/value exists, returns hints-table and #hints==expected. Missing paths assign the none enum then fall through without an explicit return; retain GagdetHintIndex spelling. Returns when Warzone UI is hidden. Requires console, message and primary client; computes names/colors and localized message. Console path writes line fields with reversed-language ordering (missing secondary text is not cleared in the reversed branch), then forces subscriptions. PC path shows a formatted game event using secondary player when present, otherwise primary. No server callout generation or log persistence is proved.
